answer.question: What is included in internships at Icanio Tech School?
answer.answer: Internships at Icanio Tech School include structured learning phases, a live project based on real client scenarios, weekly reviews and 1:1 mentorship from a practising Icanio engineer. You choose one of 15 tracks and a duration from 15 days to six months. Every intern who completes the program receives a certificate, a portfolio of work and interview preparation.

sections.heading: Internships that turn students into hires
Why our internships feel like a first job
paragraphs: Most students finish college knowing theory but not how a real team works. Our internships close that gap. You join a project team, take a brief shaped by real client work and deliver it in short sprints.

Each track follows the tools and workflows that Icanio Technologies uses on live delivery. A mentor reviews your work every week and tells you what to fix. You learn to solve problems, take feedback and explain your decisions.

By the end, you have more than a certificate. You have a project you can walk an interviewer through, and the confidence that comes from having shipped something. That is what our internships are built to give you.

sections.heading: Engineering internships: 10 tracks
sections.intro: Engineering internships suit students of CSE, IT, ECE and related branches, plus BCA, B.Sc. and MCA learners. Each track builds hands-on skills on real tech projects.

items.title: Frontend Developer
items.body: Build responsive user interfaces with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and React. You turn designs into working screens, connect them to APIs and deploy them. It is a strong start if you enjoy visual, fast feedback work.

items.title: Backend Developer
items.body: Learn how servers, APIs and databases power every app. You design endpoints, model data, handle authentication and write tests. Choose this if you like logic, structure and solving problems behind the screen.

items.title: Software Testing
items.body: Build practical QA skills in manual and automation testing. You write test cases, find and report defects, and learn how testers protect quality before every release. Detail-minded students do well here.

items.title: AI & ML
items.body: Work with real datasets, from cleaning and exploring data to training and evaluating machine learning models. You learn Python tools used in industry and apply them to practical problems.

items.title: UI/UX Designer
items.body: Design digital products from research to prototype. You interview users, map journeys, sketch wireframes and build clickable prototypes in Figma. Good for students who care about how people use technology.

items.title: DevOps
items.body: Automate how software is built, tested and released. You set up version control workflows, CI/CD pipelines, containers and cloud deployments. Pick this if you enjoy systems, scripting and reliability.

items.title: Mobile App / Flutter Developer
items.body: Create cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter, from screen layouts to state management and API calls. You finish with an app you can install on a phone and show to employers.

items.title: Full Stack Developer
items.body: Take one web product from interface to database to deployment. You work on both frontend and backend, and learn how the pieces connect. Ideal if you want a broad view of how apps are built.

items.title: Business Analyst
items.body: Analyse business requirements and plan solutions with delivery teams. You run stakeholder conversations, map processes and write clear requirement documents. Suits students who like both people and problem solving.

items.title: Project Manager
items.body: Coordinate projects from planning to delivery. You plan sprints, track tasks, manage risks and keep people aligned. Choose this if you are organised and enjoy helping a team ship on time.

sections.heading: Non-engineering internships: 5 tracks
sections.intro: Non-engineering internships build practical skills in marketing, management, finance and communication. They suit B.Com, BBA, MBA, B.Sc. and arts students, and anyone curious about business roles in a tech company.

items.title: Human Resource
items.body: Get hands-on exposure to core HR work, from recruitment and onboarding to employee engagement. You support real hiring tasks and learn how people teams run inside a growing company.

items.title: Finance
items.body: Practise core finance functions on live business tasks. You work on budgeting, reporting and financial analysis, and learn how numbers guide decisions in a real company.

items.title: Sales
items.body: Learn real sales processes through live market interactions. You practise lead generation, client communication and follow-up, and build selling skills that every business values.

items.title: Digital Marketing
items.body: Run live campaigns and real projects across content creation, social media, SEO and ads. You learn to plan a campaign, publish it and measure what worked.

items.title: Data Analyst
items.body: Work with real datasets from cleaning to visualisation and insight. You use Excel, SQL and dashboard tools to answer business questions and present what the data shows.

sections.heading: How our internships work, from application to certificate
sections.intro: Every track follows the same five steps. Our team stays with you at each one.

items.title: Apply and talk to a counsellor
items.body: Fill in the short form. Our team calls you within one working day to understand your goals, your year of study and when you can start.

items.title: Choose your track and duration
items.body: Pick one of 15 tracks and a duration from 15 days to six months. Choose offline, online, part time or hybrid, on weekdays or weekends.

items.title: Learn in phases with a mentor
items.body: Technical tracks move through four learning phases. Your mentor reviews your work each week and helps you improve.

items.title: Deliver a live project
items.body: You work on a brief drawn from Icanio client scenarios, in sprints, with the same review standards as our internal teams.

items.title: Get certified and career ready
items.body: Finish with a certificate, a portfolio review and mock interviews. Top performers are referred to the Icanio talent team.

sections.heading: Why join our internship program?
sections.intro: Four things make our internships different from a course or a certificate you can buy online.

items.title: Live project experience
items.body: You work on real-time projects that show you how an application is built from start to finish. You see planning, building, testing and release, not just one slice of it.

items.title: Flexible learning options
items.body: Instructor-led classes run on weekdays and weekends, in offline, online and hybrid modes. You can fit your internship around college, exams or a job.

items.title: Customise your internship
items.body: Choose a duration that matches your goal, from a 15 day introduction to a six month deep dive. Longer internships include bigger projects and more phases.

items.title: Interview and career guidance
items.body: You get continuous interview preparation, resume building, mock interviews and career mentoring. Our goal is to make you ready for your first job, not just finish a course.

sections.heading: Learn from engineers who build real products
sections.intro: Our mentors are not full-time lecturers. They work on active Icanio client projects.
paragraphs: Icanio Technologies is a Tamil Nadu based AI company trusted by 100+ businesses. Icanio Tech School is its education arm. The mentor who reviews your work reviews client work every week.

Every trainer has 3+ years of client delivery experience and is background verified by Icanio HR. Code reviews follow internal Icanio standards. This is why our internships teach habits that hiring managers look for, not just syntax.

In our experience, students who get hired fastest can explain a real project, the trade-offs they made and what they would change. Our internships give you that story, along with a mentor who helps you tell it well.

faqs.q: Which internships does Icanio Tech School offer?
faqs.a: We offer 15 internships. Engineering tracks are Frontend, Backend, Full Stack, Software Testing, AI & ML, UI/UX, DevOps, Flutter, Business Analyst and Project Management. Non-engineering tracks are Human Resource, Finance, Sales, Digital Marketing and Data Analyst. Each track has its own page with the curriculum, tools and projects.

faqs.q: Who can apply for these internships?
faqs.a: College students in any year, recent graduates, career switchers and self-taught learners can apply. Most interns are in their pre-final or final year of B.E., B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, MCA, B.Com, BBA or MBA. If you are unsure about eligibility, apply anyway and our team will guide you to a suitable track.

faqs.q: How do I choose between engineering and non-engineering internships?
faqs.a: Start with what you enjoy and what you have studied. If you like coding, design or systems, look at the engineering tracks. If you prefer people, numbers or marketing, the non-engineering tracks fit better. Our counsellors talk through your background on the first call and suggest one or two options.

faqs.q: How long do the internships last?
faqs.a: You choose the length. Options run from 15 days and one month up to three and six months. Short internships give you a focused introduction. Longer ones add more learning phases and a larger live project, which makes your portfolio much stronger when you apply for jobs.

faqs.q: Are the internships offline or online?
faqs.a: Both. You can attend offline at our centre, learn online, choose a part-time batch or mix modes in a hybrid plan. Weekday and weekend batches are available, so you can plan your internship around classes, exams or work.

faqs.q: Do I get a certificate after completing an internship?
faqs.a: Yes. Every student who completes one of our internships receives an Icanio Tech School certificate that states the track and duration. You also leave with a portfolio of the work you did, which employers often find more convincing than the certificate alone.

faqs.q: Will I work on real projects during the internship?
faqs.a: Yes. Every intern works on a brief drawn from Icanio client scenarios. You work in sprints, with weekly reviews from a practising engineer or domain lead. The goal is to give you the same experience you would get in the first months of a real job.

faqs.q: Do your internships help with placement?
faqs.a: Our internships include resume building, mock interviews and career mentoring. Top performers are referred to the Icanio Technologies talent team for internship and associate roles. Across our programs, 1,000+ students have been placed, and 90% of them within five months.

takeaways: Icanio Tech School offers 15 internships: 10 engineering tracks and 5 non-engineering tracks.
Durations run from 15 days to six months, in offline, online, part-time or hybrid mode.
Every intern works on a live project brief with weekly reviews from a practising Icanio mentor.
Internships end with a certificate, a portfolio, mock interviews and resume support.
Our team calls every applicant within one working day to help choose the right track.
conclusion: Choosing between internships is easier when you can see every option side by side. Start with the track that matches what you enjoy, then pick a duration that fits your semester.
If you are still unsure, that is normal. Send the form and our team will call you, talk through your background and help you choose. Most students start within a few weeks of applying.
